if test -e "$target"; then
  probe="$target"
  echo PATH_PRESENT
else
  probe="$target"

    if test "$parent" = "$probe"; then break; fi
    probe="$parent"
  done
  echo PATH_MISSING_CHECKING_PARENT
  echo NEAREST_EXISTING_PARENT="$probe"

  if test -w "$probe"; then echo PATH_OR_PARENT_WRITABLE; else echo PATH_OR_PARENT_NOT_WRITABLE; fi
  echo RESOLVED_PATH="$(readlink -f -- "$probe")"

fi
